svg.text: JAEN Smart Learning Platform — UML Deployment Diagram
Domain-driven microservices on Spring Cloud · SWD392 Group 5 · notation per Visual Paradigm UML Deployment guide
React — Learner / Editor / Instructor / Admin UI
Spring Cloud Gateway: routing · JWT · CORS
UML Deployment Notation (per Visual Paradigm — “What is Deployment Diagram?”)
3-D box = node: «device» (hardware host) / «executionEnvironment» (software runtime). A node may reside within a node (nesting).
«component» = software unit deployed on a node; «artifact» = deployable item (e.g. a database). Packages group nodes into the 3 logical layers.
Solid line = communication path between nodes, labelled with its «protocol» stereotype (HTTPS, REST, AMQP, JDBC, ...).
Dashed open arrow = «dependency» from an internal service onto an «external system» node (3rd-party / SaaS).
